coverage.explanation: Specifies the clockwise direction. Under the compilation semantics, clockwise/顺时针 maps to a negative turn angle; it does not add an action.
Requests exactly one turn action. It does not create repetition, ordering, or an edit.
Supplies the turn magnitude of 45 degrees. Combined with the clockwise direction, this yields angle_deg = -45.0.
